Questions carry either 1 mark or 2 marks

For a wrong answer to an MCQ, there will be negative marking. For a 1-mark MCQ, 1/3 will be deducted for a wrong answer. Likewise, for 2-mark MCQ, 2/3 will be deducted for a wrong answer.
There is no negative marking for wrong answers to MSQ and NAT questions.
There is no partial marking for any question.
